outputs.explanation: Panel A contains micrographs plus a bar chart (lower graph) of HMGB1 signal intensity (mean ± SD, N=4, n>100 per group). Bars are shown only with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel B contains micrographs plus a bar chart (lower graph) of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD, N=4, n>400). Only bars with error bars are shown, no individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image only, with no plotted average data requiring individual points.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks). Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points would make them unreadable.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at three time points). Line plots are exempt from this check.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G consists of immunofluorescence micrographs only, with no averaged data plotted.
Panel H shows two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and number of Purkinje cells), mean ± SD across N=3 mice, n=9 fields. No individual data points are overlaid on either bar chart.
